decisions.reason: As an adjacent analytics module with its own page and likely low incremental cost on the existing platform, its value is still resolving and it is too early to abandon the option.
This gas tariff comparison offer is close to the core customer problem, was actively presented on its own page, and is worth keeping while market uptake becomes clearer.

A regional electricity tariff calculator fits the firm's established utility-process portfolio and, with dedicated web presentation, still has enough unresolved upside to justify staying on the market.
Because it was only mentioned on the website and overlaps with stronger tariff-calculation products, its option value looks weaker than the opportunity cost of continued attention.
The regional area definition tool appears strategically useful for several location-based applications and the central platform, so keeping this option open has good spillover value.
This site-specific energy tariff comparison was only lightly signaled and is redundant with better-positioned comparison offerings, so resources are better redeployed.
